caption: Capalbio walls and Aldobrandeschi fortress, Capalbio
composition: Compact medieval stone walls and keep crowning a green Maremma hill · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The walled town crowns its green hill at the center, the full circuit of medieval walls ringing the clustered houses with the fortress keep rising above them, and the Maremma plain stretching hazily away on both sides. At 14:21 the afternoon sun is warm and clear, and the town sits like a crown on the wooded slope. The unbroken ring of the walls is the picture's defining line.
